hypothesis: R1 sub-ignition exploratory path preserves gate selectivity, the K2 sole-path guarantee, and K1-K4 verdicts, while recovering frozen phases at theta=0.6.
interpretation: WIRE. All five preregistered gates passed on fresh seeds. R1 recovers frozen phases (phase-2 'c' 0.0->0.79-0.81, total 84-85->128-129) with zero consumer deliveries on sub-ignition trials and an untouched ignition gate.
limitations: Single lab, no independent replication (matches the lane's standing REPRODUCED bar — not yet claimed). R1's recovery feeds the gain loop via the standard per-tick feedback item; under sparse reward the NR-A-006 bound still applies.
method_correction: First (a1) implementation compared raw item_ids and failed on seed 51502 (ws-586 vs ws-1186) despite identical ignition decisions: workspace_buffer.BoundedWorkspace._ids is a process-global itertools counter, so the second condition in the same process continues the first condition's numbering. Harness artifact, not a behavioral difference — verified by hand: same tick, same bids, same winner, one ignition each. Corrected by resetting the counter between conditions and comparing behavioral content (ignited item id+strength, competed bids, winner) per tick. The preregistration above is unchanged; this note is the honest record of the fix.
null_hypothesis: R1 fails to recover the freeze on fresh seeds, or alters ignition selectivity, or leaks content to consumers on sub-ignition trials, or degrades K4 below R 1.30 -> REJECT.

post_wire_reruns.note: All four receipts byte-identical after wiring: at theta=0.45 the sub-ignition path never fires in the K2/K4 scenarios (every tick ignites at least once), so behavior is preserved exactly; the exploratory path activates only in the sub-ignition regime it was designed for (theta=0.6 stationarity).

wire.change: WorkspaceTick._select_action default: no-proposal branch now returns (decision['winner'], {'path': 'sub_ignition_explore'}) instead of (self._last_action, {'path': 'hold'}). No broadcast items exist on this path; the ignition gate still decides ALL propagation.
